c74object.name: evi_korgms20
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Korg OTA dual-amplifier modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation with simultaneous outputs
c74object.description:
evi_korgms20 is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_korgms20.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_tanh.genexpr, evi_interp.genexpr
evi_korgms20 is also available in MSP as: evi.korgms20~.
The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This Korg filter sits inbetween the more broken evi.korgms10~ and the more stable evi.korgms20.select~. It is aggressive but predictable.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz. Filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.94. Filter resonance 0..1 (0.01..1.476). As in the original analog circuit, highpass output level is resonance dependent!

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: If on (1) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0, the default), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter, but is expensive because of the multimode outputs.
